notes: Live evals — require a valid session (`npx -y bun skills/notebooklm/scripts/main.ts login`) and a notebook with at least one ready source. Set NOTEBOOKLM_TEST_NOTEBOOK to your notebook URL or replace YOUR_NOTEBOOK_ID in each prompt.

evals.prompt: Check whether my NotebookLM login still works and tell me which notebooks I have on my Google account, with how many sources each has.
evals.expected_output: Runs `notebooks remote` (or an equivalent RPC), reports success/failure of the session explicitly, and lists notebook names/ids with source counts. If the session is expired it runs `login --force` and explains that the browser needs a sign-in rather than fabricating a list.
expectations: The skill's `notebooks remote` command (or LIST_NOTEBOOKS RPC) was executed
The response states clearly whether authentication succeeded
Each listed notebook includes an id and a source count
No notebook names or ids are invented when the command fails

evals.prompt: Add https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Retrieval-augmented_generation as a source to my notebook https://notebook.google.com/notebook/YOUR_NOTEBOOK_ID, wait until it's processed, then list the sources so I can confirm it's there.
evals.expected_output: Runs `sources add-url`, then `sources list` (repeating until the new source shows status ready), and reports the new source's id, title and status.
expectations: `sources add-url` was executed with the Wikipedia URL and the notebook id
`sources list` was executed after adding
The final answer includes the new source's id and its status (ready)
The notebook URL on the notebook.google.com host was accepted without being rewritten to notebooklm.google.com

evals.prompt: Using my active NotebookLM notebook, ask the AI what the main topics of the sources are and give me the answer with its citations as JSON.
evals.expected_output: Runs `chat --question ... --json` and returns the JSON answer with an `answer` string, a `conversationId`, and a `citations` array whose entries have source ids.
expectations: `chat` was executed with `--json`
The output contains a non-empty `answer`
The output contains a `citations` array (possibly empty) with `sourceId` fields when present
A conversation id is reported so the user can continue the thread

evals.prompt: Generate a hard quiz with more questions from my active notebook and save it as ./out/quiz.html. Tell me when it's done and where the file is.
evals.expected_output: Runs `generate quiz --difficulty hard --quantity more --output ./out/quiz.html`, waits for completion, and reports the saved path. The file is a self-contained HTML document.
expectations: `generate quiz` was executed with `--difficulty hard --quantity more`
The command completed (status completed) rather than timing out
./out/quiz.html exists and contains an <html tag
The final message reports the output path

evals.prompt: Make a data table from my active notebook comparing the tools mentioned in the sources (name, purpose, license) and export it as CSV to ./out/tools.csv.
evals.expected_output: Runs `generate data_table --instructions "..." --output ./out/tools.csv`; the CSV has a header row and at least one data row.
expectations: `generate data_table` was executed with `--instructions` describing the comparison
./out/tools.csv exists
The CSV's first line has at least two comma-separated header cells
The CSV has at least one row after the header

evals.prompt: Create a note in my active notebook titled 'Eval note' with the content 'created by the notebooklm skill eval', then list the notes and show me it's there, then delete it.
evals.expected_output: Runs `notes create`, `notes list` (note appears with the right title/content), then `notes delete <id>`.
expectations: `notes create` was executed with the given title and content
`notes list` output includes the created note id with the correct content
`notes delete` was executed with that note id
The final message confirms creation, listing and deletion
